title: Isotopes, Isobars, Isotones, Isoelectronic & Isodiaphers
notes:
Subatomic Relationship Classes

  • Isotopes: Same Z (protons), diff A (neutrons). E.g. ¹H, ²H (Deuterium), ³H (Tritium - radioactive β-emitter).
  • Isobars: Same A (mass), diff Z. E.g. ¹⁴C and ¹⁴N, ⁴⁰Ar and ⁴⁰Ca.
  • Isotones: Same number of neutrons (n = A − Z). E.g. ³⁰Si, ³¹P, ³²S (all n = 16).
  • Isoelectronic: Same electron count. 10-e⁻ series: N³⁻, O²⁻, F⁻, Ne, Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺.
  • Isodiaphers: Same neutron excess (A − 2Z or N − Z). E.g. ³H and ¹⁹F (both excess = 1).
summary: Isotopes, Isobars, Isotones, Isoelectronic species, and Isodiaphers.
